definitions.gloss: to strain, to filter, to sieve
definitions.explanation: To pass a liquid or mixture through a cloth, sieve, or other filter to separate solids from liquids or to achieve a smoother texture. Common in cooking and traditional crafts.

examples.english: To strain the dashi stock through a cloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漉|こ}して⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Strain the soup to make it smooth.

examples.japanese: {茶|ちゃ}こし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漉|こ}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please strain the tea leaves with a tea strainer before pouring into the cup.

notes:
USAGE:
A godan verb ({漉|こ}す → {漉|こ}します). Often written in hiragana as こす since the kanji {漉|こ} is not in the standard-use kanji list. Primarily a cooking and craft term.

Note: The homophones ⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧ (to cross over) and ⟦{超|こ}す→超す：02465_kosu⟧ (to exceed) are completely different words.

Also used in the compound ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漉|す}く (to make paper by hand), though this uses a different reading of the same kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漉|こ}す: to strain through cloth
- ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漉|こ}す: to strain through a colander
- ⟦{裏|うら}{漉|ご}し→裏漉し：23464_uragoshi⟧: straining through a sieve (noun form)
- だし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漉|こ}す: to strain stock
